description: Razón ambulancias en Bogotá D.C. is a dataset listed in City of Bogotá open data portal (Datos Abiertos Bogotá), an open data portal, published or maintained by Secretaría Distrital de Salud - SDS. Descripción: Es la relación entre el número de ambulancias disponibles y la población en una determinada área geográfica en un período dado, expresada por 1.000 habitantes. Coverage: Bogotá. The portal files it under the publisher Secretaría Distrital de Salud - SDS. Its tags are SERVICIOS DE SALUD, Salud Bogotá, Salud y Protección Social, salud, salud bogota. It offers 2 resource(s) in CSV. The portal shows 2026-05-07 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-bogota-portal.
